stories.title: Airbus engineers lift more than 365 tonnes in Wales Air Ambulance challenge
stories.summary: A team of Airbus engineers took on the ultimate powerlifting challenge of lifting the equivalent of more than two Airbus A350s in aid of the Wales Air Ambulance. stories.title: Chester Zoo: ‘World-first’ cancer treatment saves python after tumour destroys part of her jaw
stories.summary: A 15-foot python at Chester Zoo has been declared free of cancer after vets adapted a treatment used on human patients for use in a snake. stories.title: Welsh Government fund offers £50,000 to £250,000 for new equipment and technology
stories.summary: Businesses and public bodies in Wales can apply for grants of between £50,000 and £250,000 towards new equipment and technology, under a Welsh Government fund that closes next month. stories.title: Flintshire’s funding formula is under review, but not in time for next year’s budget
stories.summary: The Welsh Government has commissioned a review of the formula used to decide how much funding Flintshire County Council receives, with any change unable to take effect before 2028-29. stories.title: Oakenholt mill gets £2.85m upgrade with hydrogen-ready burners
stories.summary: Essity is to spend £2.85 million upgrading the paper machine at its Oakenholt mill near Flint. The Swedish company, whose brands include Velvet, Cushelle, Tork and TENA, said the work will replace the machine’s hood, burner and heat exchange systems.
